name: @shinsa/desktop
description: Shinsa for Mac: a window around shinsa serve

scripts.build: bun build src/main/index.ts --outfile dist/main.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron && bun build src/preload/index.ts --outfile dist/preload.cjs --target browser --format cjs --external electron
scripts.package: bun run --cwd ../web build && bun ../server/scripts/build-engine.ts && bun run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=null && codesign --force --deep --sign - release/mac-arm64/Shinsa.app
